dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: #I looove playing Dodoco's Bomb-Tastic Adventure with you, {M#Mr.}{F#Miss} Honorary Knight and Paimon! Thanks for playing with me.

choices.text: I'm having fun too! One more round!
Should we walk you back home later?

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Oh, right, I can't stay out too late... I'll behave and go home when it's time for bed!

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: But I know my way home! Let's meet back here in the morning!

choices.text: Let's take a break and continue later.

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Sure! You don't have to stay here if you have other things to do.

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: We still have loads of time, so I'll be waiting for you here during the day if you want to play more!
